title: angadenia cubensis
intro: Angadenia cubensis, commonly known as "Queen of the Night," is a flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. The health benefits of Angadenia cubensis include its potential to aid in sleep regulation, reduce anxiety and stress, and improve overall relaxation. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its sedative and anxiolytic properties, which can help individuals overcome insomnia and restlessness. The bioactive constituents of Angadenia cubensis include alkaloids, such as angadoline and scoline, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
